trigger.note: Single trigger path: a base paid spin (ST43) carrying ReMarks='TriggerFreespin' and the marker pid 666 (pays 0 credits, never a real win) opens the NormalFreeSpin session (ST106, cost=0 free reel spins on skin 8, ReMarks='FreeSpin <N>'). GameplayTriggerType is uniformly 0 on ST106 (no per-round trigger-path discriminator => single path, no trigger_paths block). ST106 wins settle on natural payline pids (4/5/6/7...), so no SynthesizePayIdRule is needed; the 666 anchor is always 0 and additive-free (WinCredits==sum(payid) on 41,719/41,719 rounds).

validation.evidence: W1 (data-derived, single v3 real chunk, single md5 bucket 3c5bcc46.../e98a4687...; 41,719 rounds): ST inventory = exactly 2 STs. ST43 = paid base spin (cost=1000, ReelSkin 1, full standard-reel signature, payid win-driven; 374/40,000 rounds carry ReMarks='TriggerFreespin' + pid 666:0 = the freespin trigger). ST106 = NormalFreeSpin (cost=0 FREE reel spin, ReelSkin 8, ReMarks='FreeSpin <N>', natural payline payids 4/5/6/7; GTT uniformly 0). Roles derived from the machine's OWN fields (paid_spin = reel+cost>0; freespin = reel+cost0+granted-session ReMarks 'FreeSpin'). play keys = the server analysisResult FeatureWin taxonomy ('Normal' base / 'NormalFreeSpin' feature). Economy invariant: WinCredits==sum(payid) on 41,719/41,719 rounds; pid 666 pays 0 on 573/573 occurrences (trigger/marker anchor, never a real win => no double-count). NO live collect-coin channel (SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols/AccCredits absent on both STs; only RewardLastNode = the standard winning-node marker is populated). freespin role is fleet-wired (ROLE_ANALYSES['freespin']->freespin_dynamics) so ST106 pulls in freespin_dynamics with NO new code and NO machine_spec change. Manifest-only onboard; base_hash unchanged at 3ddaa183f38c.
caveats: Single freespin trigger path (no GameplayTriggerType discriminator on ST106): no trigger_paths block, unlike M275's dual scatter/collect-peak split.
